description: Rothco's Large Camo Transport Pack is designed to meet all your tactical and outdoor adventure needs. With dimensions of approximately 19 inch x 15 inch x 8 inch, it offers ample storage space for your gear. Equipped with a hydration bladder-compatible pouch, you can stay hydrated during long treks. The lining and pockets feature a water-repellent coating to protect your belongings from moisture and the elements. Heavy-duty zippers with main compartment zippers extending the length of the bag allow for easy access and storage of your essentials. Additionally, the pack features a removable waist belt to aid in weight distribution and pack stabilization. The adjustable padded shoulder straps with quick-release buckles ensure a comfortable fit and allow for quick removal or dropping of the bag in case of an emergency. This MOLLE-compatible tactical bag is made of heavy-weight polyester material for durability (except for Multicam, which is made with 1000D Cordura Nylon fabric). The front zippered compartment with an exterior zippered pouch provides convenient storage options. The padded mesh back adds comfort and ventilation during extended wear. With a drag handle, quick-release top and side adjustable web straps, and a cinch strap, this pack offers versatility and functionality. Available in various camouflage colors, including Multicam, it allows you to blend seamlessly into your surroundings. The MOLLE compatibility allows you to attach additional pouches and accessories, while the large main compartment features an interior mesh zippered pocket for organization. Whether you're on a hiking trip, camping excursion, or outdoor adventure, the Rothco Large Camo Transport Pack is your reliable companion for carrying all your essentials comfortably and securely. Rothco stands out as the leader in camouflage clothing and accessories. With a rich heritage spanning over 7 decades, we have honed our expertise in crafting durable and effective camouflage gear. Our extensive range of products, including apparel, bags, and gear, showcases a diverse selection of camouflage, with over 35 patterns available! From outdoor enthusiasts and active-duty personnel, to skate and fashion, Rothco is the go-to brand for camo.
